mapping_semantics: Each audit band maps to its six independent v3 GraphHopper leg receipt identifiers per profile; street_ref evidence is retained where present. GraphHopper public API did not expose OSM way IDs, so no exact way IDs are asserted.
limitations: Replay fixture import is not an operational graph import.
v3 receipts establish graph representability only, not current passability, legality, status, or recommendation.
